title: 1 Amazon vs 50 Pawns
summary: Despite the title, this is 'How many Amazons to beat 50 pawns': on a 10x12 board (files A-L, ranks 1-10) Tony's king + N Amazons (queen + knight) face Fairy-Stockfish's king and 50 pawns in a massive interlocking phalanx. One amazon gets steamrolled; he adds amazons each game and finally mates on h10 with four Amazons (~11:30). Purple board this episode.
rules: Player: king + N Amazons (N starts at 1; +1 after each loss). Opponent: king + 50 pawns occupying ranks ~4-10 in front of it (frame estimate).
Pawns move/capture/promote normally (promotion on rank 1 for Black).
win_condition: Checkmate the pawn side's king; won with 4 Amazons.

board.shape_notes: 12x10 rectangle (transcript says '10x12'; frame shows files A-L, ranks 1-10)
board.theme_notes: purple/lavender board (Tony 'sneakily' turned on purple); green move dots, red check square

setup: Black: king near the top centre + 50 pawns as a dense block across ranks ~4-10 (exact layout visual-only). White: king + N amazons on rank 1-2.
current_impl_issues: Impl 'lone' D50 uses a single amazon on 8x8; video is 12x10 with an amazon count that increments per loss up to 4, vs 50 pawns.
evidence: 0:01-0:03 'how many Amazons I need to beat 50 pawns... queen and a knight... pawns to Stockfish'; 0:24 'This is a 10x12 board'; 11:30 'checkmate with four Amazons'; 11:37 purple board. Frame visual_c files A-L ranks 1-10, purple.
